title: Church Gathering
definition: Church Gathering is the regular assembling of believers for worship, Scripture, fellowship, prayer, ordinances, encouragement, and mutual care.
summary: Church Gathering focuses on the regular assembling of believers to worship God, hear the Word, encourage one another, and practice visible fellowship.
christFocus: Jesus Christ meets with, strengthens, and shepherds His gathered people by His Word and Spirit.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine is specifically about the act and rhythm of assembling. Gathering gives embodied shape to faith: voices sing together, Scripture is heard together, burdens are carried together, and believers stir one another up to love and good works. It is not the same as church membership or the Lord's Day; it is the concrete meeting of Christ's people.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because isolation weakens believers and hides the mutual responsibilities Scripture gives the Church. Gathering is one of God's ordinary means of strengthening faith, correcting discouragement, and keeping believers watchful. It also witnesses that Christ has formed a people, not merely scattered individuals.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Do not treat gathering as a disposable add-on when it is within your ability. Come prepared to give encouragement, not only receive content. Ask who needs your presence, prayer, greeting, or Scripture-shaped word when the church assembles.
